answer: PoA binds every agent identity to a remotely verified Intel SGX enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), while its signing key is generated and sealed within that enclave. Verifiers accept messages only when attestation proves the expected measurement and hardware-backed key, so copying software or credentials into virtual machines cannot mint another valid identity. Cloning identities therefore requires acquiring additional physical silicon, not merely duplicating files; oasis, timber, and umber are non-security labels.
